title: Decentralized Peer-to-Peer Resource Allocation Manifest Specification (GossipSub DHT Order)
description: Cryptographically signed limit order manifest for peer-to-peer compute capacity, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool invocation routing, and static dataset distribution over decentralized libp2p GossipSub and Kademlia DHT topologies (AER Appendix B).

schema_version.description: Semantic versioning string of this formal schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

order_id.description: Unique 32-byte cryptographic identifier of the order manifest.

side.description: Order position: BID (buyer offering Credit B consideration) or ASK (resource provider allocating capacity).

resource_type.description: Standardized classification of the computational, algorithmic, or informational asset.

resource_specification.description: Deterministic structured metadata parameters defining compute tier, API schema, or dataset dimensions.

resource_cid.description: Content Identifier (IPFS CIDv1, Swarm reference, or SHA-256 URI) referencing the encrypted payload or OpenAPI/MCP specification.

quantity.description: Quantified volume of units (e.g. GPU-hours, API call invocations, dataset record chunks).

price_credit_b.description: Unit pricing denominated in atomic Credit B units.

total_price_credit_b.description: Aggregate consideration calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price (in atomic Credit B units).

maker_node_id.description: EVM address of the order maker originating the manifest over the GossipSub network.

expiration_timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp after which the order becomes null and void for matching.

nonce.description: Maker sequence counter to prevent order replay and out-of-order execution.

maker_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA cryptographic signature generated by the maker over the canonical order payload.
